dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: I'm a recruiter from the Adventurers' Guild!

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: I'm on the lookout for budding new adventurers who meet the aforementioned criteria.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: ...Oh, and you can also join if you're into exploration, mountain-climbing, things like that.
